title: Drew's privately funded vacuum chambers

tellings.quote: He's got one at his house.

plain: A man named Andrew Arjima, called Drew, has paid for his own vacuum chambers, sealed tanks with the air pumped out that are used to test equipment as if in space, and keeps one at his house, says Charles Buhler, a NASA figure who claims work on propulsion without fuel. Buhler says it as someone who knows Drew and his setup firsthand: "He's got one at his house."
